methodology.daily: 100 × (dated regular daily quote close / previous completed session quote close − 1)
methodology.weekly: 100 × (2026-10-19 close / 2026-10-12 close − 1); five completed sessions October 13,14,15,16,19
methodology.monthly: 100 × (2026-10-19 close / 2026-09-18 close − 1); calendar-month target September 19 is Saturday, so latest prior trading session September 18
methodology.membership: Retained complete 201/150 issuer + independent roster corroborated constituent sets from October 16, retrieved October 17. No claim that October 19 membership was recertified.
methodology.prices: October 19 dated Yahoo regular close compared with retained issuer historical valuations. Every historical price date used by the displayed daily/week/month rankings matches the same Yahoo quote series exactly. Six non-boundary Yahoo Samsung Biologics historical observations differ from issuer values; the unchanged issuer valuations are retained, never overwritten with the inconsistent Yahoo observations.
methodology.adjustments: Unadjusted price-return basis within checked window. No dividend total-return claim. Adjacent day discontinuity screening is not a full corporate-action database audit.
methodology.rejectedSource: October 20 requested issuer basket still returned effective October 19 valuation of October 16. Undated curp and NAVER AFTER_MARKET quotes are not substituted for October 19 regular closes.
